gen-gf-waiting-for-the-sunrise-archivo: Friendly and inviting, Waiting for the Sunrise writes in loose handwriting, while Archivo sits beneath it as a plain sans with a tall, confident x-height. Handwriting with a sturdy partner makes the strongest quality here.
gen-gf-wallpoet-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Stencil-cut and loud, Wallpoet rises tall with gaps where the paper shows through. Be Vietnam Pro follows as a plain sans with smooth curves, though a small heading would lose those gaps.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Wallpoet is all cut lines, with paper showing through its letters. Noto Sans Buginese keeps short ascenders and open, chalk-arc curves in a sans-serif body, and shrinking the heading would blur Wallpoet's gaps.
gen-gf-walter-turncoat-fs-karma: Loose and marker-drawn, Walter Turncoat looks scribbled with a relaxed hand. Karma then offers a classic serif with a soft cadence of fuller stems and slimmer links: the heading brings casual charm, the body brings quiet trust.
gen-gf-warnes-fs-quicksand: Quicksand arrives first, a plain sans with tall, rounded bowls like blown glass bulbs and terminals held clear of the stem. And Warnes, stretched and spacious with ink strokes tapering out, earns its keep when set big and short.
gen-gf-warnes-fs-ranade: Ranade reads like a plain sans with a slight, rubbery shift in weight and stroke ends set far apart, giving the line a spread-out look. Warnes has no thick-thin contrast, so a long page stays smooth.
gen-gf-zen-maru-gothic-fs-literata: Rounded and modern up top. Zen Maru Gothic keeps its crossbars and stems at one width, while Literata, a text serif, shows a restrained step between its stems and connecting strokes, so the two feel clearly different.
gen-gf-zhi-mang-xing-fs-literata: Literata reads like a classic serif with sturdy strokes and open curves. Over a longer stretch its measured thick-thin ratio stays kind to the eye, while Zhi Mang Xing adds a relaxed marker-traced heading.
gen-gloria-hallelujah-fs-neco: Neco reads as a text serif with a measured swell from hairline to stem and curves that never pinch shut. Its dignity against Gloria Hallelujah's comic, pen-and-paper energy is the strongest quality.
gen-gloria-hallelujah-fs-rowan: Rowan reads as a friendly text serif with generous openings in every curve. Gloria Hallelujah's bent-pipe strokes get lost if the heading is made small, so Rowan keeps its subtle weight gradient.
